description: Read entries from a workspace's audit log, optionally within a sequence range and filtered by method, sender or task.

filter.description: Narrows the entries returned. Conditions combine with AND, and are applied within the sequence window rather than before it.

from.description: Return only entries whose actor is this participant URI.

method.description: Return only entries for this CHAP method, e.g. 'decide.override'. Matched in full, without the 'chap.' tool-name prefix.

task_id.description: Return only entries about this task.

range.description: Sequence window to return. Omit for the whole log.

name: chap.audit.read
title: chap.audit.read
